Got Questions ?

We've Got Answers

We are always happy to hear from you. If you have any questions, suggestions or opinions, please do not hesitate to reach out to us.

Contact Us

## How can I purchase a ticket from Shohoz Platform?

Please visit our website [www.shohoz.com](https://www.shohoz.com) or download our mobile App.  
[Download App For Android](https://play.google.com/store/search?q=shohoz&c=apps)  
[Download App For IOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shohoz-app/id1354321445)  
Or call our helpline number at [16374](tel:16374) for ticket purchase and for more information.

## Is there any time frame to buy a ticket?

There is no time limit to buy tickets from our website or app. But if a customer wants to purchase a ticket through our helpline number, then the customer should call our helpline number [16374](tel:16374) **( Operation Time- 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM )**.

## What is the process of Migrate or Cancelling a ticket?

For cancellation and migration, customers must have 12/24 hours before trip departure time depending on the operator. For migration, customers must call our helpline number [16374](tel:16374). Also, the customer must call from his ticket booking number. Also, a customer can cancel a ticket from our website if he has enough time from the trip departure time (12/24 hours excluding 11 PM to 7 AM).

## How can I check Shohoz's offers?

Customers can check our offers on our website. Firstly, go to our website then Click 'BUS' option, and then go to the '[Deals and offers](/deals-and-offers)' option. Customers also can call our helpline number [16374](tel:16374) for more queries and offers.

## After purchasing a ticket from Shohoz, I cancelled that ticket due to a personal issue or the operator cancelled their trip. But I have not received my refund yet. What should I do now?

As per our [refund policy](/cancellation-and-refunds), it takes maximum of 5-7 working days for Bkash and Nagad both. For Internet banking, Debit cards and Credit cards it takes maximum of 7-10 working days. If the customer did not get the refund in mentioned timeline, please call [16374](tel:16374) or mail us at [info@shohoz.com](mailto:info@shohoz.com).

{"type":"text","text":"

Based strictly on the page:

**1. Customer support**
- Helpline: **16374**
- Operating hours: **7:00 AM to 11:00 PM**
- Support email: **info@shohoz.com**

**2. Cancellation & migration rules**
- Customers must have **12/24 hours before trip departure time** (depending on the operator).
- Migration: must call the helpline 16374.
- Cancellation via website is allowed if there's enough time (12/24 hours).
- Hours explicitly **excluded** from the cancellation window: **11 PM to 7 AM**.
- Strict rule for migration phone number: the customer **must call from the same ticket booking number** (the number used to book the ticket).

**3. Refund timeline**
- **bKash / Nagad:** maximum **5–7 working days**.
- **Internet banking / Debit cards / Credit cards:** maximum **7–10 working days**.

**4. Ticket search bar**
- **Trip types:** One Way, Round Way.
- **Fields:** From, To, Journey Date, Return Date (with a "+ Add Return Trip" option and a date calendar).
- **Actions:** "Search" button.

**5. Operators & single-account services**
- Operators: **100+ operators nationwide** (the page states "access to 100+ operators nationwide").
- Services under the single Shohoz account: **Bus, Air, Train, Launch, Event, and Park (Beta)** tickets.","time":{"start":1792367696056,"end":1792367700973}}
